{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Check the revenue column for thousands separators
print("First 5 values of revenue:")
print(df['revenue'].head())

# Check for non-numeric characters
print("\nAny non-numeric characters in revenue?")
print(df['revenue'].str.contains(r'[^0-9.,]', na=False).any())

# Check if any revenue values are 999999.99 (QA test orders)
qa_orders = df[df['revenue'] == '999999.99']
print(f"\nNumber of QA test orders (revenue = 999999.99): {len(qa_orders)}")

# Check if any revenue values are non-numeric after stripping
revenue_clean = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False)
print("\nAny non-numeric values after removing commas?")
print(revenue_clean.str.contains(r'[^0-9.]', na=False).any())"}
